steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen for the RFQ event.
Provide the required event title so the RFQ can be published.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add one product for the vendor bid.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet for the line item.
Invite one QA vendor company, whose first user will submit the initial bid.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published project page.
Assert that the first vendor bid was accepted.

args.need: sign in as the second user of the same invited vendor company in a separate vendor session, open this live RFQ, submit a bid of 98, and record whether Procol refuses it with the same-company bid message or treats it as a revision

steps.note: A second user session for the same vendor company is not available in the catalog.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the resulting vendor response state.
Verify that the buyer still sees one direct response column for the vendor company, whether the second attempt was refused or revised.
